input: Use Hendersonville and Henderson County summer camp guides and roundups (Hendersonville Lightning, Blue Ridge Now / Times-News, county recreation) to find organizations running summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens. For each organization listed, give the organization's own official URL (search for it), never the listing page.
searches: Hendersonville summer camps 2026 Hands On Flat Rock Playhouse
Green River Preserve 2026 dates camp official

candidates.name: Henderson County Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Summer day camps and sports skill camps, including volleyball in July 2026.

candidates.name: Town of Fletcher Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer day camp with swimming, field trips, crafts, sports and nature activities.

candidates.name: Blue Ridge Community College
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Academy career and technical camps; additional locations in Hendersonville and Brevard.

candidates.name: Flat Rock Playhouse
candidates.note: 2026 Playhouse Jr. acting and musical-theatre camps for rising K–12 students.

candidates.name: Hands On! Children's Museum
candidates.note: 2026 full-day STEAM-themed camps for rising grades 1–3, with extended care.

candidates.name: Henderson County Family YMCA
candidates.note: Supervised summer day camp with recreation and learning activities.

candidates.name: Hendersonville High School
candidates.note: Camp of Champions youth soccer sessions; school also lists a Bearcat basketball camp.

candidates.name: Henderson County 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 FRESH summer goat-care program at Carl Sandburg Home; gardening programs also in Hendersonville.

candidates.name: Camp Tekoa
candidates.note: 2026 day, overnight and adventure camps for school-age children and teens.

candidates.name: Kanuga
candidates.note: Camp Kanuga overnight programs, Kanuga Day Camp and Camp Bob outreach camps.

candidates.name: Blue Star Camps
candidates.note: Jewish coed overnight summer camp for ages 6–16; operated in 2026.

candidates.name: Camp Pinnacle
candidates.note: Coed overnight summer sessions; documented camper arrivals in June 2026.

candidates.name: Camp Ton-A-Wandah
candidates.note: Girls' overnight summer camp with outdoor, waterfront, arts and riding activities.

candidates.name: Camp Wayfarer
candidates.note: 2027 overnight sessions announced for boys and girls, including shorter introductory stays.

candidates.name: Falling Creek Camp
candidates.note: Boys' overnight camps with 2026 and 2027 sessions for elementary students through teens.

candidates.name: Green River Preserve
candidates.note: 2027 enrollment open for coed nature-focused overnight camps and teen expeditions.

candidates.name: Discovery Trails Learning Academy
candidates.note: Weekly themed summer day camps with field trips, outdoor skills, science and arts.
